figurative_meaning_en: A generous or big-hearted person; a wealthy or influential individual
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন বড়মানুষ, সবসময় দান করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a big man, always donating to causes.
The village bigwig helps everyone in need.
note: Refers to social hierarchy in Bengali culture, often implying both wealth and benevolence.
